lines: Status 285, 1:25 PM MT Nov 28. Nothing is asked of you right now. The next thing to listen to is Preview 14, the opening alone with the three sound changes below, due by 2:05 PM.

Heard from your messages of 1:11 and 1:15 PM through Partner (decision 335). The opening's picture and speed stand. The keys are not changed: the copy you heard had been raised 10 dB by Partner, and measured here from the two delivered files the typing sits at -30.1 LUFS in this opening and -30.1 in Halation v2's film, with the music after it at -14.0 and -14.6. Three things are ordered, at no credit and with nothing generated. One: Halation's soft tick on both presses of the usage change. Two: Halation's Send sound in place of this build's own, at a level that can be heard. Three: the first sound within 0.9 seconds and the first key within 2.0 seconds, where there were 2.5 seconds of silence. How any of it sounds is unknown here until you listen.
Sound credits stand at 7,420 of 10,000 and stay there: music 4,851, sound effects 2,569.

Since 1:01 PM. The first load's lost picture on Macs (open item 295, decision 334): on hosted Macs the page as it is lost its live picture in 17 of 32 loads, and with the canvas held at a hair of opacity instead of none it lost 0 of 20, measured by the item's finder. That one value is ordered as a mend with a paired proof, due 2:30 PM, then a fresh reviewer. Real Apple machines are unknown. Two what-ifs came back and are recorded, not offered (decision 336); their pictures are attached. Summer's and winter's air kept misty through the storm's gap closes the gap and costs the plainest sight of the tree. The sand sprinkle's loose head loses its bright point and brings eight grains that hop for a few frames. No further what-if is ordered.

Phases 0 to 5 are complete. Phase 6, the films, in four steps. One: the opening's sound and timing change goes to the main branch after a fresh reviewer has read it; its builder's whole report is due 3:00 PM. Two: the render handoff for your PC passed its hosted proof, 10 of 10 jobs; its last reading is under way, answer due 2:20 PM, then it goes to the main branch as one file to follow. Three: the 4K render runs on your PC when you start it. Four: you receive With Prompt, Without Prompt, Portfolio Looping Video and Portfolio Screenshot.
Still open with you, unchanged: the two what-ifs of Preview 12 (the sand mound leaving, fall's faces going out) and the level line's mend stay off the film until you say yes.
Not verified: the sound as heard, a real desktop graphics card, a phone, Safari, Firefox, a real Apple chip for item 295.
phase 6: 65.57 h used of its 12.00 h box
allowance (after the review): 65.57 h used of 12.00 h allowed
